name: Istanbul Sabiha Gökçen International Airport

runway.v: two runways: 06R/24L 3,540 m x 60 m and 06L/24R 3,000 m x 45 m

hours.v: aerodrome administration, air traffic services, fuelling and handling 24 hours

slots.v: charter and general aviation flights must operate in the airport's non-busy hours and keep to their slot time; slots are applied for from the DHMI slot coordination centre
slots.quote: Flights other than scheduled flights (Charter, general aviation and similar) shall be operated on non-busy hours

permits.v: technical landings and diversions to Sabiha Gökçen are not accepted
permits.quote: Technical landings and diverts to Sabiha Gökçen Airport shall not be accepted.

max_aircraft.v: the general aviation apron centreline may be used under own power only by aircraft with a wingspan of up to 26.5 m; 27-31 m wingspan only on stand 61 via taxiway N
max_aircraft.quote: General Aviation (GAV) apron centerline can be used with own power only by aircraft which have max 26.5 M wingspan.

ppr.v: hangar space for visiting aircraft is limited and needs prior permission
ppr.quote: 5 Hangar space for visiting aircraft Limited PPR

fuel.v: Jet A-1, through the fuelling services
fuel.quote: 2 Fuel/oil types Jet A1, Connect with fueling services

noise.v: departures by ICAO Chapter 3 aircraft fly noise abatement procedure NADP-2; Chapter 2 aircraft NADP-1 only
noise.quote: For departures any aircraft having compliance with the Noise Category ICAO ANNEX 16, Vol-1 Chapter 3 shall apply NADP-2

notes: Read DHMI AIP Turkey AD 2 LTFJ (English PDF): AD 2.3 page AIRAC AMDT 03/26 (19 Mar 2026), AD 2.4 AMDT 11/25 (27 Nov 2025), AD 2.12 AMDT 11/24 (26 Dec 2024), AD 2.20 AMDT 10/26 (1 Oct 2026) and 07/26. Only the first 100,000 of about 118,000 characters were read. All AD 2.3 services are H24; no curfew or night restriction is stated, so none is recorded. The DHMI slot page for SAW (ltfj-dhmi-slot, no date) lists the airport as 'Level 3 (SCR)' and says GA/BA flights with more than 24 hours ground time must coordinate with the ramp. The DHMI slot NOTAMs for W25/S26 close runway 06L/24R overnight for maintenance on set weekdays (UTC windows vary); check the current NOTAM before night operations. De-icing is arranged through the handling agent (AD 2.4), not quoted exactly. IATA code not printed in the AIP.
